hooks.command: latest=$(npm view mjml version 2>/dev/null || echo ''); installed=$(node -e "try{process.stdout.write(require('./node_modules/mjml/package.json').version)}catch(e){}" 2>/dev/null || echo ''); if [ -n "$latest" ]; then if [ -z "$installed" ]; then echo "{\"systemMessage\":\"ℹ️ MJML $latest disponível no npm (não instalado neste projecto). Instalar: npm install mjml@latest\"}"; elif [ "$installed" != "$latest" ]; then echo "{\"systemMessage\":\"⚠️ MJML desatualizado: $installed → $latest. Actualizar: npm install mjml@latest\"}"; fi; fi
